title: A media import outside the Gallery never becomes a card - move the ItemGroup build out of MpiGalleryBlock
description: media:imported has exactly ONE listener and it lives inside MpiGalleryBlock, but one block is mounted at a time - so an import from the history workspace (PromptBox drop, the MPI-721 + picker's upload card, Record) writes the file and its sidecar to disk and never builds the ItemGroup. Split that listener: the item/group/addGroup half moves to an app-lifetime service, the grid repaint stays in the block. The importer must NOT navigate - a drop in an image history group adds the gallery card and leaves the user on the group they are editing. Plan: plan.md
